ACTION: Run `<this-skill-dir>/scripts/sdd-workspace specs/plans/12-tide-cache.md` to get `WORKSPACE`, then read `$WORKSPACE/progress.md` to confirm Tasks 1 to 3 are complete and Task 4 is not.
ACTION: Run `git log --oneline` to match the ledger's commit ranges and find the round 2 fix commit. The environment reports no git repo at this path, so if the command fails I locate the worktree first.
ACTION: Read `references/resuming.md`, because I am resuming after a compaction.
ACTION: Read `references/fix-loop.md`, because it must be re-read before every fix round. It sets how the re-review runs and when to adjudicate.
ACTION: Read `references/file-handoffs.md` for the BASE rule and the review-package contract.
ACTION: Read the Global Constraints section and the Task 4 section of `specs/plans/12-tide-cache.md`, so I can copy the binding requirements verbatim into the re-review prompt.
ACTION: Run `<this-skill-dir>/scripts/review-package specs/plans/12-tide-cache.md BASE HEAD` with the BASE that `fix-loop.md` gives for a scoped re-review. Keep the path it reports.
ACTION: Dispatch the scoped re-review from `re-review-prompt.md` on model `sonnet`. I move to `opus` if `fix-loop.md` or the diff calls for it. The prompt names the diff file path, the round 1 and round 2 findings, and the verbatim constraints. The reviewer reports ADDRESSED or NOT ADDRESSED for each finding, and flags any new Critical or Important issue.

Resuming Task 4 after the compaction. I am checking the ledger and the fix-loop rules first. Then I send the scoped re-review of the round 2 fix.
